title: stardust rollout/coverage/templates.json
description: Template grouping for delivery. A template is the structure shared by a set of migrated pages; rollout uses it to deliver a representative page first (establishing the EDS block library), to drive block reuse, and to roll up per-template delivery progress. Derived from the agnostic _meta.json / canon at inventory time; carries the requested URLs of its pages and, once judged, a name and a description. Owned by stardust:rollout. Part of the coverage contract a client reads: strict here because it describes exactly what stardust writes.

formatVersion.description: Coverage format version (semver). Before 1.0.0 a release may still change the shape; from 1.0.0 (declared once a client has shipped against it) a minor release only adds fields, clients ignore fields they do not know, and removing or renaming a field is a major release. Writers since stardust 0.34.0 always emit it; files written earlier lack it.

name.description: Judged kebab-case name (workspace/judgement.json); present only when judged.

description.description: Judged one-sentence description (workspace/judgement.json); present only when judged.

type.description: The agnostic page type of the representative page: its sidecar type, else its state.json type, else null. Informational for rollout.

representativeSlug.description: The page rollout delivers first to establish this template's EDS block library; siblings then reuse those blocks.

representativeUrl.description: The representative page's source.sourceUrl, or null.

urls.description: Source URLs of the template's pages: the representative's first, the rest sorted; unique, unknown URLs skipped.

delivery.description: Roll-up of this template's pages by delivery progress.

contentPending.description: Archetypes-only roster siblings that push no document of their own.
